programs.feeNote: Tuition only: INR 12.00 lakh for the entire programme, payable in 4 equal semester instalments; exact fee indicated in offer letter. 2025-27 batch per semester: tuition 3,00,000 + other charges 22,400 + institute residence fee 8,600 (SC/ST/PwD pay only other charges and residence fee). Hostel/mess not included.

programs.placementNote: DMS IIT Delhi Final Placement Report 2023-2025 (MBA & MBA Telecom): 98% placement, median INR 22,50,782, average INR 22,52,966, female average 23,28,717, highest 43,55,300. 2024-26 final report not yet published. No audit mentioned. Figures read from PDF text where trailing digits were clipped; matched to full values.
